resources.title: Starting or Returning to Honkai Star Rail in 2026? Here's What to Do First
resources.creator: Moon
resources.noteEs: Guía concisa de 8 minutos para nuevos y returning players en 2026 (4.0+). Cubre prioridades de cuenta, daily routine y qué eventos rendir primero. Buen primer click si abres el juego después de meses sin tocarlo.
resources.noteEn: Concise 8-minute guide for new and returning players in 2026 (4.0+). Covers account priorities, daily routine, and which events to clear first. A good first click if you open the game after months away.

resources.title: What it's like to Start Honkai: Star Rail in 2026
resources.creator: Braxophone
resources.noteEs: Documental de 1h24 sobre la experiencia de empezar HSR en 2026 con todo el contenido acumulado. Útil si te abruma la cantidad de story, eventos y warps disponibles después de 3 años. Braxophone analiza qué se siente accesible vs apabullante.
resources.noteEn: 1h24 documentary on the experience of starting HSR in 2026 with all accumulated content. Useful if you're overwhelmed by the amount of story, events, and warps available after 3 years. Braxophone analyzes what feels accessible vs overwhelming.

resources.title: Can A Returning Player Beat HSR in 1 Week?
resources.creator: Rhinne
resources.noteEs: Experimento de un returning player tratando de completar endgame (MoC, AS, PF) en 7 días. Útil para entender cuánto trabajo requiere ponerte al día sin invertir meses. Realista, no aspiracional.
resources.noteEn: Experiment of a returning player trying to complete endgame (MoC, AS, PF) in 7 days. Useful for understanding how much work it takes to catch up without investing months. Realistic, not aspirational.

resources.title: Returning to Honkai Star Rail in 2026 | I Was NOT Ready for This
resources.creator: Kuroi
resources.noteEn: First-person account of returning to HSR after a long break. Highlights the power-creep shock, story complexity, and which systems changed. Good companion piece to the Rhinne experiment — same angle, different style.
resources.noteEs: Relato en primera persona de volver a HSR después de un break largo. Destaca el shock de power-creep, complejidad de story, y qué sistemas cambiaron. Buen complemento al experimento de Rhinne — mismo ángulo, distinto estilo.

resources.title: DON'T MAKE THESE MISTAKES! Best Beginners Guide to Honkai: Star Rail
resources.creator: Braxophone
resources.noteEs: Guía de 34 minutos enfocada en los errores comunes que los principiantes cometen — desde leveling de personajes equivocados hasta gastar trailblaze power mal. La mayoría de tips siguen vigentes en 2026, solo cambian los meta units.
resources.noteEn: 34-minute guide focused on the common mistakes beginners make — from leveling the wrong characters to misspending trailblaze power. Most tips still apply in 2026, only the meta units change.
